Priya: FYI we promoted the adaptive-prefetch v1.2 canary (15%) at 2026-02-12T14:04:00Z. quick summary: p50 down ~~20% on few-shot completions, token cost down ~11% on avg, small uptick in tail for heavy-long sessions.
Jonas: Nice! Are those steady-state numbers or warmed-up?
Priya: Warmed-up (30m warm period) and included a 2h rolling window from prod traffic + our long-context synthetic suite.
Marta: Can you drop the bench snapshot here?
Priya: Paste from the perf dash: 
```
route                p50_base p50_canary p99_base p99_canary tokens_per_1k_base tokens_per_1k_canary
fewshot-complete     78ms     61ms       410ms    430ms       $0.045               $0.040
rerank-heavy         110ms    95ms       680ms    695ms       $0.052               $0.046
long-session (12k)   240ms    255ms      1200ms   1260ms      $0.095               $0.098
```
Priya: Notes: long-session p50/p99 regressed ~6-7% — root cause seems to be more aggressive prefetch touching KV lanes and causing occasional write locks on the hot-prefix path.
Lee: Any effect on autoscaler/queue backpressure?
Priya: We saw a ~3% increase in ephemeral queue length on some pods during peaks, but CPU/GPU utilization remained within target. Autoscaler reacted as expected.
Jonas: What flags did you toggle? can we scope down for long-context only?
Priya: We enabled adaptive-prefetch heuristics based on token-likelihood and recent-KV-hit-rate. There's a disable flag for routes: --prefetch-disable-long-sessions that we can flip if the regression persists.
Marta: Rollout plan?
Priya: Plan: 15% -> 40% after 2h if no perf alerts -> 70% over 12h -> monitor 48h before 100%. Manual rollback if p99 > 1.4x baseline for >20min or cost regression >8% sustained.
ops-bot: deploy: adaptive-prefetch v1.2 -> canary(15%) by priya@infra at 2026-02-12T14:04:00Z
Lee: Could we add a temporary exception that forces old prefetch for sessions >8k tokens? might be faster than full rollback.
Priya: Good idea. I'll push a targeted route exception to the canary config and re-evaluate within the hour.
Jonas: Please file a short postmortem if long-context tail stays worse after the route exception. Capture bench artifacts.
Priya: Will do. Posting dash links and the canary artifacts in the release thread now. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
